description: An AI-filed Need rejected without adoption. It carries no adoptedBy because nobody adopted it.
specRow: S4.3 proposed → withdrawn; S9.4 NEED-DOC-001 does not fire when an ai-proposed record withdrawn from proposed carries no adoptedBy.

needsDocument.title: Benefits assistance -- who this is for and why

statement.who: anyone filling out this application on a phone
statement.want: to start on my phone and finish later on a computer
statement.why: losing twenty minutes of answers means many people never come back
statement.done: when I come back on any device, my answers are where I left them

excerpt.exact: I screenshot every confirmation page because they lost my renewal once.

note: Design-choice record, not a divergence, and the case S6 rule 4 is scoped around: the rule requires adoptedBy on an ai-proposed record at a status reached *through adoption* — `adopted` or `superseded` — because S4.3's transition table reaches `withdrawn` directly from `proposed` without one. Schema and checker agree: neither requires adoptedBy here, and both refuse a non-human adoptedBy wherever one does appear on an ai-proposed record. A withdrawn-without-adoption record is conformant, and the withdrawal is itself evidence.
